variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Home world declines route expansion request
variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: No assent to the colony's shipping plea
